q: Which products are dragging that down?
answer:
By product (order date), product-level net profit after modelled ad allocation shows a few clear drains: the largest is an unattributed row (net loss -₹4,40,739 with ₹4,85,102 of allocated ad spend), then SnugSole Boots (-₹14,420, ad spend ₹28,076, net sales ₹45,020, 34 orders), WingBird Smart Flapping Toy (-₹11,042, ad spend ₹66,015, net sales ₹92,912, 94 orders) and Ave Walk Harness Set (-₹10,414, ad spend ₹12,646, net sales ₹17,023, 15 orders). This means we are buying sales on these lines but they still lose money after the modelled ad allocation.

- Unattributed (no product title): loss -₹4,40,739 vs allocated ad spend ₹4,85,102 — the single biggest drag; could be uncredited spend or allocation that didn’t match sold lines.  
- SnugSole Boots: loss -₹14,420 on ₹28k ad spend and ₹45k sales (34 orders) — ad spend appears to be buying low-margin or loss-making units.  
- WingBird Smart Flapping Toy: loss -₹11,042 despite ₹92,912 sales (94 orders) and high allocated spend (₹66,015) — conversion volume but not profitable after COGS/allocations.  
- Ave Walk Harness Set: loss -₹10,414 on smaller sales (₹17,023, 15 orders) and modest ad spend (₹12,646) — low scale and negative unit economics.

Numbers are product-level net profit after modelled ad allocation (order-date). Note: the result is composed from two views (ad allocation and product P&L); some products don’t appear in both parts (missing = no data, not zero).

Worth checking: investigate the unattributed allocation, and drill these products by ad platform → campaign → creative to find which ads are buying loss-making sales.

Period: 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-28 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-28
